questions.text:
Sachin purchased 10 kg of rice at the rate of ₹36 per kg and 32 kg of rice at ₹46 per kg. He sold
the whole mixture at the rate of ₹42.5 per kg. Find his loss (in ₹).

The equation ax² + bx + c = 0 has imaginary roots. The constants a, b and c are three consecutive
natural numbers. We may take a, b and c in ascending or descending order, the roots are still
imaginary. What can be the smallest value of a?
What is the value of the following expression? cot 22° × cot 43° × cot 45° × cot 47° × cot 68°

A car can travel 600 km in a full tank of petrol, whose capacity is 48 liters. Find the distance
travelled by car with 31 liters of petrol.

A and B working together can do a piece of work in 6 days. B alone can do the same work in 15
days. How long (in days) will A alone take to do thrice the work?
A regular hexagon has a side length of 22 cm. Find its area (in cm²). (Use √3 = 1.7)

If the compound interest on a sum of ₹y at 10% per annum compounded annually for 2 years is
₹735, then the total amount payable at the end of the two-year period will be ________.

What is the minimum value that must be assigned to A so that the 8-digit number 447A3439 is
divisible by 11?

12 chairs and 2 tables cost ₹1,300 and 10 chairs and 14 tables cost ₹5,400. What is the cost of 6
chairs and 9 tables?

Find the least 4-digit number which when divided by 12, 15, 18, and 24 leaves a remainder of 7 in
each case.
The product of two numbers is 4107 and their HCF is 37. How many such pairs of numbers exist?

A shopkeeper marks an article 40% above its cost price and gives two successive discounts of
15% and 10%. If he earns a profit of ₹106.50, find the cost price of the article.

The difference between compound interest and simple interest on a certain sum at 12% per
annum for 2 years is ₹180. What is the compound interest on the same sum for 2 years at 10% per
annum?

In a mixture of 84 liters, the ratio of milk to water is 5 : 2. How much water should be added to the
mixture so that the ratio of milk to water becomes 3 : 2?

A, B, and C started a business with capitals in the ratio 3 : 4 : 5. After 4 months, A withdrew half
of his capital and B doubled his capital. At the end of the year, the total profit was ₹65,600. Find C's
share in the profit.

A train 240 m long crosses a platform of length 360 m in 30 seconds. How long will it take to
cross another train of length 180 m running in the opposite direction at 54 km/h?

A boat takes 5 hours in total to travel 48 km downstream and 48 km upstream. If the speed of the
stream is 4 km/h, what is the speed of the boat in still water?

The average weight of 24 students in a class is 45 kg. When the weight of the teacher is
included, the average increases by 1.5 kg. What is the weight of the teacher?

Six years ago, the ratio of the ages of Kunal and Sagar was 6 : 5. Four years hence, the ratio of
their ages will be 11 : 10. What is Sagar's present age?
If x + 1/x = 5, find the value of x³ + 1/x³ − 3(x² + 1/x²).
If 2sin²θ + 3cosθ = 3, where 0° < θ < 90°, then what is the value of θ?

In an election between two candidates, 10% of the voters did not cast their votes and 10% of the
votes polled were declared invalid. The winning candidate got 54% of the valid votes and won by 1,620
votes. Find the total number of voters enrolled.
Find the sum of all 2-digit numbers that leave a remainder of 3 when divided by 7.

The ratio of the incomes of A and B is 5 : 4 and the ratio of their expenditures is 3 : 2. If each
saves ₹3,200 at the end of the month, find the income of A.

A man sells two articles at ₹9,900 each. On one he gains 10% and on the other he loses 10%.
What is his overall profit or loss (in ₹)?

If log₁₀(2) = 0.3010 and log₁₀(3) = 0.4771, find the value of log₁₀(45).

A sum of money becomes 3 times itself in 8 years at simple interest. In how many years will it
become 7 times itself at the same rate?
What is the unit digit of (247)⁸³ × (623)⁴⁵ + (178)³⁶?

The roots of the quadratic equation x² − kx + 36 = 0 are in the ratio 1 : 4. If k > 0, find the value of
k.

Two dice are thrown simultaneously. What is the probability of getting a sum that is a prime
number?

A hollow cylindrical iron pipe is 21 cm long and its outer and inner diameters are 10 cm and 6 cm
respectively. Find the volume of iron used in making the pipe. (Use π = 22/7)
How many 4-digit even numbers can be formed using the digits 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 without repetition?

A car travels the first one-third of a distance at 30 km/h, the next one-third at 45 km/h, and the
last one-third at 90 km/h. Find the average speed for the entire journey.

What is the central angle corresponding to the expenditure on Healthcare and Agriculture
together?
By how much (in ₹) does the expenditure on Infrastructure exceed that on Administration?

If the allocation for Education is increased by 20% and that for Agriculture is decreased by 10%
next month, what will be the new combined expenditure on these two heads?
Which district recorded the highest qualification percentage in the year 2025?
What is the average number of candidates who qualified from all five districts together in 2026?

Find the ratio of total candidates appeared from Puri across all three years to total candidates
qualified from Sambalpur across all three years.

A, B, C, D, E, F and G sit around a circular table facing the centre. Only two people sit between D
and F when counted from the right of D. Only two people sit between F and C when counted from the
right of F. Only three people sit between D and A when counted from the right of D. E sits to the
immediate left of B. How many people sit between A and B when counted from the right of B?
What should come in place of the question mark (?) in the given series? 31, 42, 64, 108, 196, ?

Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a
certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster DOES NOT belong to that group?

Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike
in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group?

Refer to the given letter series and answer the question that follows (counting left to right only):
(Left) I D X S H D X X Q E J V H E Q O I V P O E (Right). How many such vowels are there, each of which
is immediately preceded by a consonant and also immediately followed by a vowel?

In a certain code language, ‘right handed person’ is coded as ‘ub kc sp’ and ‘they are right’ is
coded as ‘kc nv ty’. How is ‘right’ coded in the given language?

1 6 @ 7 L Q 9 M L © N 1 Q A £ Q € (Right). If all the letters are dropped from the series, which of the
following will be sixth from the left?

E, F, G, Q, R and S live on six different floors of the same building (numbered 1 at bottom to 6 at
top). Only two people live between Q and F. Only two people live between R and G. Only one person
lives between S and G. No one lives below S. Q lives above G. How many people live below E?

In a certain code language, ‘A + B’ means ‘A is the son of B’, ‘A − B’ means ‘A is the brother of B’, ‘A
× B’ means ‘A is the wife of B’ and ‘A ÷ B’ means ‘A is the father of B’. How is T related to K if ‘T ÷ G × D −
M + K’?
Find the missing number in the series: 7, 15, 32, 67, 138, ?
Find the wrong term in the series: 12, 18, 30, 54, 102, 196, 390

Select the option that is related to the third term in the same way as the second term is related
to the first term: BENGAL : DGQKEQ :: ODISHA : ?
In a certain code language, ‘MONKEY’ is written as ‘XDJMNL’. How is ‘TIGER’ written in that code?

If ‘P × Q’ means ‘P is the mother of Q’, ‘P + Q’ means ‘P is the brother of Q’, and ‘P ÷ Q’ means ‘P is
the daughter of Q’, then which expression shows that M is the maternal grandfather of N? (Assume ‘P −
Q’ means ‘P is the father of Q’.)
options:
N × R − M

questions.text:
A man walks 12 m North, turns right and walks 9 m, then turns left and walks 8 m, and finally
turns right and walks 12 m. How far and in which direction is he from his starting point?

Eight friends P, Q, R, S, T, U, V, and W sit in a straight line facing North. P sits fourth to the left of
T, and neither sits at an extreme end. S sits second to the right of P. Q is an immediate neighbour of T
and sits at an extreme end. U sits second to the left of Q. R sits to the immediate right of V. W does not
sit at any extreme end. Who sits at the extreme right end?
If 15th August 2024 was a Thursday, what day of the week will 15th August 2027 be?
Find the reflex angle between the hour hand and the minute hand of a clock at 4:40 PM.

In a row of 45 students, Priya is 18th from the left end and Riya is 15th from the right end. How
many students sit between Priya and Riya?
Select the odd number pair out from the given alternatives:

Arrange the following words in a logical and meaningful order: 1. Diagnosis 2. Prescription 3.
Illness 4. Recovery 5. Consultation

How many pairs of letters are there in the word ‘CONSEQUENCE’ that have as many letters
between them in the word as in the English alphabetical order (both forward and backward)?

If ‘DELHI’ is coded as ‘73541’ and ‘CALCUTTA’ is coded as ‘82589662’, how will ‘CALICUT’ be
coded?
Find the next term in the alpha-numeric series: C4X, F9U, I16R, L25O, ?

Six boxes A, B, C, D, E, and F are stacked one above another (bottom=1, top=6). Box F is at the
bottommost position and Box B is immediately above F. Box E is immediately above Box B. Only one
box is between E and A. Box C is at the topmost position. How many boxes are placed above Box D?

Pointing to a photograph, a woman says, “He is the only son of the mother of my father’s sister.”
How is the person in the photograph related to the woman?

In a certain code, ‘329’ means ‘god is love’, ‘927’ means ‘love is blind’, and ‘475’ means ‘blind man
walks’. Which digit stands for ‘is’?

Select the option that is NOT a valid conclusion from the statement: “All engineers are analytical.
Some analytical people are musicians.”
options: All of the above are invalid.

A bus leaves a depot every 35 minutes. A passenger at the depot is told that the bus left 15
minutes ago and the next bus will leave at 10:25 AM. At what time did the passenger receive this
information?
If ‘WATER’ is written as ‘YCVGT’, how is ‘FIRE’ written in the same code?

Seven persons J, K, L, M, N, O, and P sit in a circle facing the centre. M sits second to the left of
J. P sits third to the right of M. K is an immediate neighbour of both N and O. L sits to the immediate
left of J. Who sits to the immediate left of P?
If South-East becomes North, North-East becomes West, and so on, what will West become?

A cube of side 5 cm is painted red on all faces and then cut into smaller cubes of side 1 cm each.
How many smaller cubes have exactly two faces painted?
